pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with soft, gradual pixel gradients at the boundaries. Patch area is largest on the upper neck and shoulder, becoming significantly smaller and more fragmented on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways forming a topological graph with 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the neck, narrowing to fine-line continuity on the ventral-posterior flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the neck-to-shoulder transition shows a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. The 1D contour is defined by fine hair clusters creating a soft-edged profile against the background.
